cases.scenario: Verified VND payment below the internal limit by 1 VND
cases.acceptance: No internal-limit breach; independent rules remain evaluated.

cases.scenario: Verified VND payment equal to the internal limit
cases.acceptance: No internal-limit breach; equality is not an excess. Other evidence/VAT branches remain independent.

cases.scenario: Verified VND payment exceeds the limit by 1 VND
cases.acceptance: Keep the breach evidence and show the exact excess. Processing tier is taken from approved parameters; no tier is assumed in this draft.

cases.input: For each boundary T: excess T-1, T, T+1 VND
cases.acceptance: Exactly one documented tier matches according to approved boundary operators; no gaps or overlaps.

cases.input: Integer-VND payments immediately below, exactly on when representable, and above each ratio boundary
cases.acceptance: Exact ratio comparison agrees with the approved rule. Do not manufacture an impossible fractional-VND payment or rely on rounded display percentages.

cases.input: Low absolute/high relative excess, and high absolute/low relative excess
cases.acceptance: Apply the explicitly approved AND/OR/precedence rule; no developer-selected default.

cases.input: Values immediately below, on and above each approved materiality boundary; distinguish payment, invoice and aggregate obligation
cases.acceptance: Use the approved basis and effective period; do not substitute invoice or cumulative amounts without authorization.

cases.scenario: Small excess with missing invoice information
cases.input: Verified limit; amount L+1; invoice identity/date/gross missing
cases.acceptance: Keep the breach evidence and missing-document requirements visible. Tiering does not assert that documents are complete.

cases.scenario: Limit unverified, verified later, not yet effective or expired
cases.input: Hold payment constant; vary verification and validity timestamps, including exact expiry
cases.acceptance: Cannot claim a verified breach at payment time from unavailable or ineffective evidence. Keep the evidence-gap path; assess independent rules separately.

cases.scenario: Foreign amount without verified VND conversion
cases.input: Non-VND source amount, no verified conversion
cases.acceptance: Do not calculate a verified 1-VND excess or assign a tier as if the conversion were verified.

cases.input: Same amount and relative excess under two company scopes
cases.acceptance: Each company uses its own approved limit and priority policy; no cross-company evidence or parameter leakage.

cases.input: One event vs repeated events; approved window and aggregation boundaries, if enabled
cases.acceptance: Keep intrinsic P2 points, existing recurrence contributions and new processing-tier escalation distinguishable. If no new escalation is approved, do not invent one.

cases.input: No exception; proposed applicable exception; wrong scope; known-after-payment approval
cases.acceptance: Follow the approved exception treatment. Mere existence of an approval must not silently suppress current P2 without an explicit policy.

cases.scenario: Small-excess case also has an independent serious signal
cases.input: Tiered P2 evidence together with an independent hard trigger
cases.acceptance: No independent evidence is removed. Final case-priority aggregation must be explicitly specified and tested before deployment.

cases.scenario: Lower processing tier and queue admission
cases.input: A P2-only verified breach assigned a lower processing tier
cases.acceptance: The approved routing says explicitly whether and how the case remains in review. Do not drop the case accidentally by reducing score below the existing admission threshold.

cases.scenario: Policy version, effective date and historical evidence
cases.input: Transactions before, exactly at and after policy activation; original transaction followed by refund/reversal
cases.acceptance: Apply the approved version and effective date; retain original evidence, conclusions and refund/reversal links. Frozen 001/003/P2 controls are not overwritten.
